args.script: CREATE DOMAIN sdk{{uniq}}; CREATE FEED sdk{{uniq}}.events; CREATE WRITER wr{{uniq}} TO sdk{{uniq}}.events; OPEN WRITER SESSION wr{{uniq}}; CREATE READER rd{{uniq}} FROM sdk{{uniq}}.events START AT BEGINNING; CREATE SUBSCRIPTION sdk{{uniq}}.sub FROM sdk{{uniq}}.events START AT BEGINNING;
DEFINE STATESTORE sdk{{uniq}}.profiles KEYS department, passport UNIQUE; DESCRIBE STATESTORE sdk{{uniq}}.profiles; SHOW STATESTORES;
